description: Calculate compound or simple interest, balance, total contributed, interest earned, modeled APY and yearly balances from principal, nominal rate, term and deposit timing. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

compoundingPerYear.description: Equal compounding periods per year, default 12

contribution.description: Recurring deposit per complete monthly/yearly period; default 0; simple mode requires 0 (USD; at most two decimal places)

contributionFrequency.description: Deposit interval, default monthly; fractional intervals have no deposit

contributionTiming.description: Deposit at start or end of each complete period; default end

principal.description: Initial principal (USD; at most two decimal places)

years.description: Term in years; a fractional tail earns modeled interest

name: compound_interest_calculator

outputSchema.description: USD balance, totalContributed, interestEarned, apyPercent (null for simple), table of full years and final fractional term; complete-period deposits only

title: Compound Interest Calculator
